baseline: RFC-020 mint / script / hash; lottery families removed

vectors.name: ordinary_res_two_out_inflation
vectors.note: ordinary transfer: 100 RES in, 110 out across two outputs

vectors.name: ordinary_res_amount_plus_one
vectors.note: ordinary transfer: res_out = res_in + 1

vectors.name: oru_only_creates_res
vectors.note: RFC-020: 1024 ORU is genesis-exact for 1 RES atom; at height 1 the continuous price has already moved, so this burn is insufficient

vectors.name: res_only_creates_oru
vectors.note: RES-only inputs cannot create ORU (no_res_to_oru)

vectors.name: mint_W_plus_one
vectors.note: exact epoch-0 burn covers 1 RES atom, not 2 (burn_insufficient)

vectors.name: mint_W_minus_one
vectors.note: one ORU atom short of the genesis-exact burn for a 1-atom mint

vectors.name: mint_two_res_outputs
vectors.note: mint-shape requires exactly one RES output; two outputs still fail

vectors.name: mint_genesis_W_at_epoch_1
vectors.note: calendar k=1 mint: genesis-exact 1024 ORU does not cover destroy_cost(210000)

vectors.name: winner_mint_count_two
vectors.note: observational k=251: genesis-exact burn still fails the continuous price

vectors.name: winner_omits_mint
vectors.note: H-1 omit has no referent; zero-burn ORU-to-RES is still illegal

vectors.name: cap_one_atom_overshoot
vectors.note: supply + 2 atoms = cap + 1; equal-to-cap is admitted, one atom over is not

vectors.name: at_cap_then_mint
vectors.note: exactly at the hard cap, then mint 1 atom

vectors.name: schedule_exhausted_mint
vectors.note: leftover H-1 pin: observational k=251 still authorizes mints; draw_won=false + mint_count=1 is without_winner, not RATE=0

vectors.name: without_winner_mint
vectors.note: without_winner has no referent; replaced by burn-insufficiency (1023 ORU for 1 RES)

vectors.name: mixed_ordinary_plus_illegal_mint
vectors.note: valid ordinary transfer plus burn-insufficient mint in the same body

vectors.name: mixed_inflation_plus_mint_shape
vectors.note: ordinary inflation plus a well-shaped height-1 mint (1025 ORU); body still rejected

vectors.name: amount_below_min
vectors.note: CVG2/ORU output of MIN-1 sat; IsConvergenceTx may hold (nValue>0) but F excludes it

vectors.name: amount_zero
vectors.note: CVG2 output with nValue=0 is not counted (C++ nValue>0); not a convergence tx

vectors.name: wrong_asset_res
vectors.note: abstract: CVG2 container tagged RES; Convergence is ORU-domain

vectors.name: script_res2_not_cvg2
vectors.note: Witness v1 / 32 / RES2 prefix is not CVG2 (abstract form)

vectors.name: script_p2wpkh_not_cvg2
vectors.note: Witness v0 P2WPKH-shaped script is not a Convergence output

vectors.name: two_cvg2_outputs
vectors.note: IsConvergenceTx requires exactly one CVG2-positive output

vectors.name: committed_c_bitflip
vectors.note: neg: 1-bit-flipped claimed C ≠ recomputed Convergence_Root (complement DCR-033)

vectors.name: unsorted_concat
vectors.note: neg: hashing presentation order without sort ≠ C (CR-010 pins perm of sorted concat)

vectors.name: truncated_concat
vectors.note: neg: dropping the last txid from the sorted concat changes the digest

vectors.name: claimed_root_len_31
vectors.note: neg: claimed C of length 31; honest empty C is 32 zero bytes

vectors.name: extra_byte_concat
vectors.note: neg: appending one byte to the sorted concat changes the digest

vectors.name: duplicate_txid_not_nlt2
vectors.note: neg: C([a,a]) hashes both copies (N=2); not Hash256(a) = C([a]) (complement DCR-029)

vectors.name: empty_claimed_dcr_as_c
vectors.note: neg: committing DCR(empty)=SHA-256d([]) as C of N=0; honest C is zeros (complement DCR-030)

vectors.name: singleton_claimed_zeros_as_c
vectors.note: neg: committing 32 zeros as C of N=1; honest C is Hash256(txid) (complement DCR-031)

vectors.name: v0_p2wpkh_claimed_res
vectors.note: L2: Witness v0 P2WPKH is not IsResScript (ORU domain). L3: C++ IsResScript.

vectors.name: v1_res2_claimed_oru
vectors.note: L2: Witness v1 RES2 prefix is not creatable (ASSET_INVALID). L3: ClassifyRigorTxout.

vectors.name: v1_program_len_20
vectors.note: L2: v1 program length 20 is not IsAllowedScript. L3: bad-rigor-script-type.

vectors.name: p2pkh_nonstandard
vectors.note: L2: P2PKH byte template is not a witness program. L3: bad-rigor-script-type.

vectors.name: p2sh_nonstandard
vectors.note: L2: P2SH byte template is not a witness program. L3: bad-rigor-script-type.

vectors.name: v0_p2wsh_claimed_res
vectors.note: L2: Witness v0 32-byte (P2WSH) is not IsAllowedScript. L3: ASSET_INVALID / bad-rigor-script-type.

vectors.name: pcorb_five_items
vectors.note: L2: PCORB stack length 5 < 6. L3: ParseConvergeProof fails.

vectors.name: pcorb_amount_len_7
vectors.note: L2: PCORB item[1] (amount) is 7 bytes, not 8. L3: ParseConvergeProof field-size fail.

vectors.name: witness_v2_32
vectors.note: L2: unknown witness version 2 is not IsAllowedScript. L3: bad-rigor-script-type.

vectors.name: spend_cvg2
vectors.note: L2: spending a CVG2 scriptPubKey is rejected (abstract form). L3: bad-txns-spend-convergence.

vectors.name: domain_v0_tagged_res_oru_to_res
vectors.note: CROSS dual-pool: v0-ORU script tagged RES + ORU-in creating RES-out. L2: not_res_script. L1 extra: dual_pool mint_wrong_amount (NEG-002 family).

vectors.name: mint_shape_ok_pcorb_five
vectors.note: CROSS mint-shape: body is W(h) mint-shape (would pass dual-pool) but PCORB has 5 items. L2: pcorb_too_few. L1 extra: mint_shape_would_pass=true (NEG mint-shape complement).

vectors.note: Witness v0/20 → ORU

vectors.name: native_res_rfc8032
vectors.note: Witness v1/32 RFC8032 pk1 → RES

vectors.name: op_converge
vectors.note: RIGOR_MARKER_CONVERGE → ORU

vectors.name: op_res_mint
vectors.note: RIGOR_MARKER_RES_MINT → RES

vectors.name: v0_p2wsh
vectors.note: Witness v0/32 → INVALID

vectors.note: P2PKH → INVALID

vectors.name: res2
vectors.note: RES2 prefix → INVALID

vectors.name: empty
vectors.note: Empty script → INVALID

vectors.name: op_return
vectors.note: RIGOR_MARKER_RETURN + push → NONE

vectors.name: v1_len20
vectors.note: Witness v1/20 → INVALID

vectors.name: p2pkh_plus_ordinary_inflation
vectors.note: CROSS script+dual-pool: created P2PKH (bad-rigor-script-type) and ordinary RES inflation. Both apply_tx conjuncts fail.

vectors.name: witness_v2_plus_oru_to_res
vectors.note: CROSS script+dual-pool: witness v2 created script + ORU-in creating RES-out (mint_wrong_amount). Shape and pooling both reject.

vectors.name: spend_cvg2_plus_inflation
vectors.note: CROSS script+dual-pool: spend-CVG2 (bad-txns-spend-convergence) plus ordinary RES inflation. Spend-shape and dual-pool both reject.

vectors.name: c_bitflip_plus_mint_W_plus_one
vectors.note: CROSS root+mint: committed C bitflip (ICVG-006 family) and ORU-funded 2-atom mint on a 50-ORU input (burn_insufficient). Both halves reject.

vectors.name: claimed_c_len_31_plus_cap_overshoot
vectors.note: CROSS root+cap: claimed C length 31 (ICVG-009) and one-atom hard-cap overshoot (NEG-011). Both halves reject.

vectors.name: unsorted_concat_plus_mint_at_cap
vectors.note: CROSS root+cap: unsorted concat digest ≠ C (ICVG-007) and mint at the hard cap (NEG-011). Both halves reject.

vectors.name: window_all_paid_empty_dcr_no_winner
vectors.note: CROSS window+DCR+selection: A-9-C pays the whole F. Survivors empty, C is empty-set zeros, DCR is SHA-256d([]) ≠ zeros, no winner.

vectors.name: window_drop_to_singleton_hashed
vectors.note: CROSS window+DCR+selection: pay one of two. Singleton remainder has C=DCR=Hash256(survivor) ≠ zeros, and a survivor winner (contrast unpaid 2-set).

vectors.name: window_drop_winner_moves_dcr_and_sel
vectors.note: CROSS window+DCR+selection: A-9-C drops the unpaid-set winner. Surviving list, DCR, and winner all move vs the unpaid 3-set (complements DCR-020 / DCR-032).

vectors.name: epoch_last_height_mint_next_W
vectors.note: CROSS schedule+mint-shape: last height of observational calendar 0 with a 50-ORU input cannot cover 1 RES atom. destroy_cost(h) moves at the next height.

vectors.name: W_zero_mint_last_epoch_amount
vectors.note: CROSS schedule+mint-shape: observational k=251 still has destroy_cost(h)>0; 50 ORU cannot cover 1 RES atom (burn_insufficient, not unauthorized).

vectors.name: last_positive_W_mint_plus_one_and_cap
vectors.note: CROSS schedule+mint+cap: last height of the old 251-epoch calendar, burn-insufficient mint and one-atom cap overshoot together.

vectors.name: p2sh_plus_ordinary_inflation
vectors.note: CROSS script-shape+dual-pool: created P2SH (in-model IsAllowedScript reject) plus ordinary RES inflation. Complements XFAM-000 P2PKH.

vectors.name: v1_len20_plus_ordinary_inflation
vectors.note: CROSS script-shape+dual-pool: created v1 program length 20 plus ordinary RES inflation. Complements SMW-002 (script-only).

vectors.name: opreturn_nonzero_plus_inflation
vectors.note: CROSS script-shape+dual-pool: nonzero-value OP_RETURN (the other created-script branch besides IsAllowedScript) plus ordinary inflation.

vectors.name: pcorb_five_plus_ordinary_inflation
vectors.note: CROSS PCORB-shape+dual-pool: empty created-script fixture (shape-ok on creates) but 5-item PCORB plus ordinary inflation. Complements SMW-011 (well-shaped mint + bad PCORB).

vectors.name: window_empty_plus_without_winner_mint
vectors.note: CROSS window+obligation: A-9-C empties F (no winner, C=0) and a mint is still claimed (without_winner). Does not wire Selection into cm_draw_won (P1-2).

vectors.name: window_drop_winner_plus_h1_omit
vectors.note: CROSS window+obligation: A-9-C drops the unpaid-set winner (survivor winner exists) and mint_count=0 (H-1). Complements XFAM-008 / NEG-009.

vectors.name: epoch_last_mint_plus_one_and_cap
vectors.note: CROSS first-epoch-last+cap: last height of epoch 0, burn-insufficient mint and one-atom cap overshoot. Complements XFAM-011 (last paying height).

vectors.name: epoch_start_mint_plus_one_and_cap
vectors.note: CROSS first-epoch-start+cap: first height of epoch 1, burn-insufficient mint and one-atom cap overshoot. Complements NEG-007 (wrong-epoch price).
